learning_objective: 🎯 Master the rules of positive and negative numbers to solve real-world mysteries involving freezing temperatures, submarine depths, and bank balances!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Integers are all the whole numbers, including the negative ones below zero. We use negative integers every day to show temperatures below freezing, money we owe to the bank, or how deep a submarine dives underwater!
When adding or subtracting integers, think of walking on a line. Adding a positive number means walking forward to the right. But adding a negative number is like walking backward to the left!

Multiplying integers is like a game of teams. If two numbers have the SAME signs (both positive or both negative), the answer is always positive. If the signs clash (one positive, one negative), the answer is negative!

fun_activity.title: 🧩 The Digroz Weather Tracker
fun_activity.instructions: Look up the current temperature of the coldest city and the hottest city in the world today. Use integer subtraction to calculate the exact temperature difference between them!

quick_recap: ⭐ Integers include all positive whole numbers, zero, and negative whole numbers.
⭐ When multiplying or dividing, two matching signs make a positive, and opposite signs make a negative.
⭐ Adding a negative number gives the exact same result as subtracting a positive number.
